description: Source code for a disk cache fuzzer using libFuzzer, implementing fuzzing logic for Chromium's disk cache components, including backend creation, command execution, and resource management.

classes.name: DiskCacheLPMFuzzer
classes.description: A class implementing the fuzzing logic for Chromium's disk cache components, managing backend creation, command execution, and resource cleanup.

methods.name: RunCommands
methods.description: Executes a sequence of fuzzing commands on the disk cache backend.

methods.name: HandleSetMaxSize
methods.description: Sets the maximum size of the cache.

methods.name: CreateBackend
methods.description: Creates and initializes the cache backend based on specified parameters.

methods.name: CloseAllRemainingEntries
methods.description: Closes all open cache entries to prevent resource leaks.

methods.name: RunTaskForTest
methods.description: Runs a backend task for testing purposes, waiting for completion.

methods.name: WaitOnEntry
methods.description: Waits for an asynchronous cache entry operation to complete.

methods.name: OpenCacheEntryCallback
methods.description: Callback invoked when a cache entry is opened, handling success or failure.

methods.name: IsValidEntry
methods.description: Checks if a cache entry is valid (not closed).
